text:
Dear Skype user, 
do you have questions about moving from Skype to Microsoft Teams Free? Here are answers to the most asked questions: 

(questionmark) I don’t see anything in Teams Free. Do I have to do anything? 
(checkmarkbutton)No, your contacts will transfer automatically. Check out our video on how to migrate here!

(questionmark) Can I still chat with friends who use Skype? 
 (checkmarkbutton)Yes, Microsoft Teams Free allows communication with Skype users and vice versa. Learn how to use both apps in our video!

(questionmark) What if I don’t want to move? 
 (checkmarkbutton)You can still export your data before May 5th, after this date Skype client will no longer be available to anyone. Here is our step by step guide.

 For more questions and answers, hit our FAQ pages at https://go.skype.com/teams
